notes: The Windows downloads shrink to the size class Linux has always had: the installer is now about 5 MB and the portable ZIP about 6 MB, down from 101.5 MB and 134 MB. The video components (yt-dlp, deno, ffmpeg) are no longer bundled; on first launch the app downloads them once, in the background, verifying SHA-256 hashes pinned in the app. Upgraders from 2.0.2 keep their existing components — nothing is re-downloaded. Two smaller changes ride along: row selection with Ctrl/Shift is now reliable on WebKit setups that drop modifier state from click events, and the list's right-click menu gains Select All and Delete All, for clearing the list with the mouse alone. Everything else is unchanged.
